mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to compressed discount rates on equity cash flows and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2% for the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% signals weakening labor market strength, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE exceeding 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both consumer demand (GDPC1) and business supply (INDPRO) signals a healthy economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, persistent federal funds rate below 2% lowers discount rates on equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2% for the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Consistently high labor employment (PAYEMS) above 145,858 indicates a robust labor market, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite PAYEMS remaining above 145,858.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST crossing above 1,300 units signals heightened demand for goods, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 1,300 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite HOUST exceeding 1,300.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) combined with rising consumer demand (GDPC1) creates a dual expansionary pressure, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 moving in expansionary directions.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in business supply (INDPRO) during a post-shock recovery phase indicates improved production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO rising rapidly in the recovery phase.
